en.title: Mark Wahlberg's affordable gym

en.title: British-Bangladeshi captains England kabaddi
en.text: Anisa Khan, a British-Bangladeshi athlete, has been appointed captain of England's women's kabaddi team. She becomes a prominent face for the sport in British sport.
